# LaTeX Math interactions

Cases md4c's own `spec-latex-math.txt` leaves uncovered: flanking corners, run-length
matching, the opener-stack rule, and how math interacts with the constructs md4c resolves
before it. Authored here rather than vendored, but every expected output below was captured
from `md2html --flatex-math` at the pinned md4c tag, and `scripts/verify_md4c.pl` re-checks
every one of them against that binary rather than trusting this file.

Cases where this library deliberately differs from md4c are *not* here; they are pinned in
`test/MathDivergenceGuards.lean` instead, with the reasons.

## Flanking

```````````````````````````````` example
$ 4 $
.
<p><x-equation> 4 </x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
2000$x$
.
<p>2000$x$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$x$2
.
<p>$x$2</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$x$.
.
<p><x-equation>x</x-equation>.</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
.$x$
.
<p>.<x-equation>x</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
+$x$+
.
<p>+<x-equation>x</x-equation>+</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
($x$)
.
<p>(<x-equation>x</x-equation>)</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a $x$ b
.
<p>a <x-equation>x</x-equation> b</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
π$x$
.
<p>π$x$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$x$π
.
<p>$x$π</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

## Opener stack

```````````````````````````````` example
$a $$b$$
.
<p>$a <x-equation type="display">b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$$a $b$
.
<p>$$a <x-equation>b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a $b$ c$
.
<p>$a <x-equation>b</x-equation> c$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a b$ $c$
.
<p><x-equation>a b</x-equation> <x-equation>c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$$a $b$ c$$
.
<p>$$a <x-equation>b</x-equation> c$$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a $$b$ c$$
.
<p>$a <x-equation type="display">b$ c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a $$b$$ c$
.
<p>$a <x-equation type="display">b</x-equation> c$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

## Escapes

```````````````````````````````` example
<p><x-equation>a\$b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a\$b$c$

<p>a$b$c$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\$$x$
.
<p>$<x-equation>x</x-equation></p>
.
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
.
````````````````````````````````

## Constructs resolved before math

```````````````````````````````` example
$a `$` b$
.
<p><x-equation>a `$` b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a `$ b$ c` d$
.
<p><x-equation>a `$ b$ c` d</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
`$a$`
.
<p><code>$a$</code></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
`$a` $b$
.
<p><code>$a</code> <x-equation>b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a `$` b $c$
.
<p>a <code>$</code> b <x-equation>c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a <https://x.com/$> b$
.
<p><x-equation>a &lt;https://x.com/$&gt; b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a <b$> c$
.
<p><x-equation>a &lt;b</x-equation>&gt; c$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a <b $ c> d$
.
<p><x-equation>a &lt;b </x-equation> c&gt; d$</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$[a](b)$
.
<p><x-equation>[a](b)</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[$a](b)
.
<p><a href="b">$a</a></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

## Content is opaque

```````````````````````````````` example
$b<a>c$
.
<p><x-equation>b&lt;a&gt;c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$*$
.
<p><x-equation>*</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a *b* c$
.
<p><x-equation>a *b* c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a$ *b* $c$
.
<p><x-equation>a</x-equation> <em>b</em> <x-equation>c</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$$a *b$$ c*
.
<p><x-equation type="display">a *b</x-equation> c*</p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$a $$$ b$
.
<p><x-equation>a $$$ b</x-equation></p>
.
--flatex-math
````````````````````````````````
